title: Spike's guided tour for new users
summary: Spike now gives new users a short guided tour of where things are, with separate tours for public accounts, staff and administrators.
changes: A guided tour starts on the dashboard the first time you sign in after this release.
Public accounts, staff roles and administrators each get their own tour, with Spike in every step.
Finishing or skipping the tour is saved, so it does not start again by itself.
Restart the tour at any time from Help, the Staff guide or Ctrl K search.
Each step points at something on screen on both desktop and mobile.
version_rationale: Patch within the 0.51 milestone: adds the guided tour and one nullable user column.
validation: New feature test for each audience, first-login start, skip, restart and access rules.
New JavaScript tests for step targets and saving the result.
Browser check of every step at 1280 and 630 pixels wide.
known_limitations: The tour covers the menu and main tools; it does not walk through individual forms.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The guided_tours column can stay; nothing reads it in older releases.
provenance: Milestone v0.51.2 Beta, issue #489 under epic #487, pull request #632.
